A SMALL UNIVERSE, COMING UNDONE.
JORGE LUIS BORGES / EL REMORDIMIENTO

The greatest sin.

“He cometido el peor de los pecados
que un hombre puede cometer.
No he sido feliz.”

His regret: a life in which he had not been happy.

A lifetime of imagined worlds, and still the ache of the life outside them. What does it mean to have lived, if we never let ourselves be here?

ALBERT CAMUS / RETURN TO TIPASA

An invincible summer.

“In the middle of winter I at last discovered that there was in me an invincible summer.”

And yet, something remains. A warmth that does not require the world to make sense before we begin to love it.
